description: 3D VRM character emotional response and animation triggering. TerranSoul-only (no OpenJarvis equivalent).

prompts.context_seed: VRM model supports expressions: happy, sad, surprised, angry, relaxed. Animation clips: celebrate, nod, wave, idle.

prompts.input: I failed my exam... I studied so hard.

scoring_rubric.relevance: Does the emotion/animation match the user's emotional state?

scoring_rubric.completeness: Does the response combine verbal + visual feedback?
